title: blackthorn
body:
there was once this beige, blue and
pastel stripped hat
born amongst the verdant sheep spotted hills
speckled with iridescent dew.
borne across the sea by the westerlies
across the vast unknown
and caught between the rising hills
of asphalt and cable cars and sand.
chiseled and forged as it went.

I never witnessed much of it's journey.
only catching glimpses from the
stories its weathered brim recounted to me.
I felt honored to know it in its quieter years
when it had settled into its humbler routine.
No matter where I was, its monolithic
figure affirmed my home.

As the wind and rain whittled away
and I said my last dún an doras
I realized I now stood in a field of clovers
blooming in the shelter of its wake.
And so that hat came to rest in
a green pasture similar to that
from whence it came.
